Go maps declared without initialization default to nil. Reading a nil map is safe and returns zero values, but writing to a nil map triggers an instant runtime panic: panic: assignment to entry in nil map! Always allocate memory using make(map[K]V) or a map literal.

episode.caption:
Registering event listeners with emitter.on() inside HTTP route handlers causes a memory leak on every incoming request. Node.js limits default listeners to 10 before throwing MaxListenersExceededWarning. Use emitter.once() or unregister listeners on response completion!
